outcome_mapping.note: reviewed canonical terminal-outcome mapping: legacy SubAgentResult.ok=True with every input present maps to COMPLETED; ok=True while a failed soft dep was omitted from its inputs maps to DEGRADED (the legacy engine has no degraded token — omission IS its degradation signal); ok=False from an agent error maps to FAILED; the orchestrator's 'upstream dependency failed' marker (hard dep failed; node never executed) maps to BLOCKED.
